overview.text: AgentNDX presents discovery of MCP servers, A2A agents and x402 services through curated pages and a broader backend index. Free browsing/search is separate from API Pro advertised at $29/month with key authentication and x402 queries at $0.005 USDC on Base without an account. Featured placement is advertised at $149/month, not an independent quality endorsement. Curated, indexed and verified counters describe different directory scopes and are not a tested service inventory. Quality scores, verified labels and owner intake remain directory claims, not an independent safety assessment or proof of current endpoint operation. Machine-readable discovery and MCP links describe integration access, not completed connections or successful downstream calls.
